metadata.title: CNN vs. ResNet: 1D Spectral Architecture Teardown

beats.narration_text: Hola, this is Hrishikesh. Today we compare and contrast plain Convolutional Neural Networks against Residual Networks, focusing purely on architecture: stacked one-D convolutions versus residual skip connections across one-thousand-point Raman spectra.

props.command: compare LegacyCNN vs. Raman1DCNN (ResNet) architectures: layer topology, skip connections, receptive fields, and inductive bias.

beats.narration_text: Intuition says stacking deeper convolutional layers always extracts richer spectral hierarchies. In practice, plain deep stacks suffer from vanishing gradients and degradation, whereas residual blocks reformulate layers to learn perturbations around an identity highway.

props.text:
Architectural Hypothesis
Stacking 25 plain Conv1D layers
always improves feature extraction.
Wait, plain deep stacks degrade.
ResNet adds identity shortcuts
H = F + x so gradients flow.

beats.narration_text: Compare the block topologies side by side. A plain CNN forces every layer to reconstruct the full signal representation H of x, while a residual block routes the input x around two weight layers, computing ReLU of F of x plus x.

How is our six-layer Legacy CNN constructed? Each stage applies a one-D convolution, batch normalization, ReLU activation, and average pooling, progressively halving sequence length from one thousand points down to fifteen while preserving sharp local wavenumber peaks.

props.command: inspect legacy_baseline/model.py: trace tensor shapes and pooling mechanics in LegacyCNN.
output: ✓ 6 Conv1D stages with BatchNorm1d + ReLU + AvgPool1d(2)
✓ Flatten head locks exact wavenumber peak positions

beats.narration_text: In legacy baseline model dot py, Legacy CNN chains six sequential Conv-one-D blocks without skip paths. Average pooling smooths high-frequency detector noise at each stage before flattening directly into the thirty-class linear classifier.

props.code:
class LegacyCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=30):
        super().__init__()
        # 6 plain Conv1D + BN + ReLU + AvgPool1D stages
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            self._block(1, 32, k=5),    # 1000 -> 500
            self._block(32, 64, k=5),   # 500  -> 250
            self._block(64, 64, k=5),   # 250  -> 125
            self._block(64, 128, k=5),  # 125  -> 62
            self._block(128, 128, k=5), # 62 -> 31 -> 15
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(128 * 15, num_classes)

beats.narration_text: Now examine receptive field scaling and structural depth. While Legacy CNN's six layers span up to three hundred fifteen wavenumbers to isolate narrow vibrational bands, the twenty-five-layer ResNet expands its receptive field across eight hundred ninety-five points, capturing global spectral correlations.

Why does greater depth become a double-edged sword on one-D spectra? With nearly four times the parameter capacity and a global receptive field, an unregularized ResNet memorizes background fluorescence curves unless constrained by dropout and spectral augmentation.

props.text:
Capacity vs Inductive Bias
ResNet scales to 25 layers and 512 channels
and learns generalizable peak physics.
Wait, high capacity memorizes baseline noise.
Shallow 6 layer CNN acts as a natural
structural bottleneck on raw peaks.

beats.narration_text: Comparing performance across training regimes proves the architectural tradeoff. On ten-epoch smoothed spectra, ResNet leads fifty-nine point five to fifty-three point seven percent, but on five-fold cross-validation and raw spectra, Legacy CNN's local bottleneck wins seventy-six point five and eighty-two point two percent.

In src model dot py, ResidualBlock-one-D implements the two-layer convolutional branch alongside an optional one-by-one strided projection shortcut, summing F of x and x before the final nonlinearity and global average pooling head.

Choosing between a plain CNN and a ResNet comes down to signal geometry: use shallow average-pooled CNNs when features are sharp, index-locked peaks, and deploy residual networks when global context and heavy augmentation dominate. Your turn.
